title: Granola integrations
description: A warm oat band: serif eyebrow, a huge serif headline and an ink pill, a hairline row with a serif statement left and a paragraph right, then a strip of white square tiles of gently graded sizes (largest in the middle) holding tool marks. The strip slides in from the right and keeps drifting left as you scroll past.
notes: the band is the theme's card colour
tiles show an icon (with the name for screen readers) or the name in bold type; 12+ tiles keep the strip wider than the window
CSS view timeline; without support, or with reduced motion, the strip sits centred
